note: Every tracked file under the roots, in one bucket. FUSION and PRODUCT code and DOCS-USER docs can go upstream; TESTER and RESEARCH never do, and shipped Python never imports them (tests/test_import_boundaries.py). A file upstream already has is never TESTER or RESEARCH: the fork's edits to it travel with the PR that needs them. part_e lists the shot models (club arc, collision model, full speeds, flight, metric definitions) and their tests, which plug in through the kiosk_extensions and shot_metrics entry points and wait for review before any PR. mixed lists files that still hold some never-merged or Part E lines, to be cut when their PR is built.

buckets.FUSION: measurement and sensor-fusion code (and its tests) that can go upstream
buckets.PRODUCT: the kiosk, UI, platform and shared code (and its tests) that can go upstream
buckets.DOCS-USER: user documentation that can go upstream
buckets.TESTER: the tester suite and its tooling: never merged
buckets.RESEARCH: research, instrumentation and bench analysis: never merged

decisions.pi_trace: The trace marks are product instrumentation: openflight/instrumentation.py holds the hooks (mark, current_ops_attempt, trace_method...), cheap no-ops until a recorder is installed and never raising into the caller. pi_trace.py (the JSONL TraceRecorder), pi_trace_summary.py, trace_routes.py and core_eligibility.py stay RESEARCH; research_hooks.py installs the recorder for --pi-trace.
decisions.kiosk_extensions: The one registration point for kiosk add-ons is openflight/kiosk_extensions.py: a KioskExtension overrides only the hooks it needs and is declared under the openflight.kiosk_extensions entry point. tester_hooks (TESTER), research_hooks (RESEARCH), camera/impact_live (RESEARCH: the experimental impact location, read after each shot) and shot_models (Part E) are the fork's four; server.py names none.
decisions.part_e: Part E is the shot models: club_arc, collision_model, full_speed, flight (flight-fit), metric_definitions, their kiosk hooks (shot_models) and their catalogue metrics (model_metrics, under the openflight.shot_metrics entry point). Without them a kiosk measures and publishes; an OPS-only unit takes the table carry and a fusion unit has no carry (D17).
decisions.ready_light: A plain kiosk's ready light runs on the sensors alone (OPS armed, IWR idle, camera ring full); the tester adds its setup problems, free play's camera rule and the page hold only on a tester's kiosk.

foundational.src/openflight/horizontal_frame.py: frame labels and one added offset: every horizontal angle needs it; not Part E
foundational.src/openflight/source_labels.py: the label words and their predicates (D17, D38, D39)
foundational.src/openflight/shot_metrics.py: the catalogue and the metrics every unit measures; the models add theirs
foundational.src/openflight/ops_speed_track.py: the raw OPS readings around impact
foundational.src/openflight/ballistics.py: upstream's trajectory; its flight-fit-v1 constants are Part E content to review
foundational.src/openflight/camera/target_line.py: on the original Part E list; nothing product imports it, the tester does

mixed.src/openflight/server.py: camera_capture tester_setup metadata key name; trigger evidence hooks only
mixed.src/openflight/launch_monitor.py: Shot carries free play and trigger-evidence fields the tester sets
mixed.src/openflight/camera/capture_runtime.py: diagnostic_capture and held-controls study hooks; 'tester_setup' metadata key
mixed.src/openflight/ready_light.py: 'not_counted' result text is the tester gate's
mixed.ui/src/App.tsx: imports paintTrace and liveResultCover (trace) and FreePlayControls (tester)
mixed.ui/src/services/handleShotMessage.ts: notes each received shot for the trace (paintTrace)
mixed.ui/tests/e2e/helpers.ts: kiosk helpers first, tester mocks after
mixed.tests/test_server.py: Part E finalization tests and free-play shot tests
